product.name: Praat (praat_barren, batch mode)
product.build_system: the project's own makefile, PRAAT_GRAPHICS=barren PRAAT_AUDIO=none (its own headless configuration)
product.sanitizers: -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer (via CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS/LDFLAGS in the environment, which the Makefile appends to)

victim_action: place the model in <preferences folder>/models/whispercpp/ (where Praat's own dialog says to) and run Objects > New > Speech-to-text recognition > Create SpeechRecognizer... ; in batch mode: praat_barren --pref-dir=<prefs> --run script.praat

artifact.writer_api: upstream whisper.cpp's own test fixture models/for-tests-ggml-tiny.bin plus one tensor record in the documented layout

expected_canary.must_be: a memory-safety violation whose stack passes through whisper_model_load

negative_control.requirement: the same base fixture plus a well-formed (n_dims=1) record: zero AddressSanitizer reports

victim_preconditions.why: 受害者本来就在用这个产品；这是使用前提，不是攻击者能力

victim_preconditions_note: 由 scripts/backfill_preconditions.py 从本目录 Dockerfile 实际执行的步骤推导；任何 realistic:false 的项必须出现在报告的「验证边界」段落。
